description: Look up whether a chain head (64 hex chars, the `chain` of a proof's last checkpoint) was published to the I, Pencil registry on Base. With a pointer (the transaction hash a proof carries) this is one exact check at any age. Without one it searches recent blocks only, and a miss means 'not found in the blocks searched', never 'not registered'. A registration records publication by an address, not ownership or authorship.

maxRequests.description: Search budget when there is no pointer. Default 24 (about 6 hours of history).

network.description: Base network. Defaults to the proof's own registry.chain, else Base mainnet. Use "sepolia" only for test registrations.

txHash.description: Optional. The registration transaction the proof points to.

name: check_registration
title: Check a chain head on the registry
